todo: Purpose: Repeat power hardware on Lumen’s exterior and Halcyon’s hull while named wing layouts stay custom.
Visual brief: Rigid blue-black panels on visible angled struts; a thin lit upper rim, darker side edge and a seated foot make the panel a volume. Cell pattern is quiet enough to avoid moiré.
Widths and size: Proposed 168–288 art px wide, 45–89 high per ground rack; no matching density-3 class, review at 74-art-px adult scale.
Implement after review: choose authored anchors, exact collision and approved variant art; these cell envelopes are layout proposals, not measured sprite bounds.
Wings and ground racks have distinct anchor/collision rules; generating power is scenery here, not a new energy economy.
Lighting: Upper left; material-specific ramps and directional planes; no mirror-only relighting.
